gpu_tip: ~44GB total at 128K context — the smallest build Unsloth publishes, and a last resort: 1-bit quality loss is large even with Unsloth's dynamic layout. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 48GB DDR5 kit runs it via expert offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~44GB — tight on a 48GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max); a 64GB config leaves headroom.
